title: console: a record whose approval_status reads pending is shown "locked for approval" with Edit disabled even when the approvals read answers 200 with no request, so a composition without the approvals service locks records forever
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect with reach measured (class a). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` execution seat (seat post objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1353, `session_01WnMDsLSaUQUD41WaWnADcF`) from the dev report on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2067 (PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2075). ⛔ Not graded here: objectui triage grades and routes. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

On a composition without the approvals service (every hosted free-plan environment; any deployment that leaves `ApprovalsServicePlugin` out), a record whose `approval_status` column reads `pending` opens with the band 「审批中已锁定」, Edit disabled, and 撤回审批 / 待审批 offered. 撤回审批 only fires `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?recordId=…&object=…`, which answers **200 `{"data":[]}`**, and nothing changes. The server does not enforce the lock: `PATCH /api/v1/data/<object>/<id>` answers 200.

Reach, measured:
- the hosted reproduction on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2067 (three accounts, HotCRM 4.0.1 on the free plan: badge, disabled Edit, the empty approvals read, the 200 PATCH);
- the dev's local probe on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0 without `ApprovalsServicePlugin`: the account stored `pending`, 0 requests, the approvals read 200 `{"data":[]}`.

## Where the lock comes from

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (around lines 1486–1491 at the dev's reading) sets `approvalLocked` from the literal column (`approval_status === 'pending'` or `'in_approval'`) whenever `approvals.pendingRequest` is null.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` (around lines 1637–1644) does the same.
- The fallback is documented for backends that expose **no** approvals API. A backend whose approvals read answers 200 with an empty list does expose one, so the fallback fires where it was never meant to, and it reads the literal column name rather than the flow's declared `approvalStatusField`.

Line numbers are the dev's reading on objectui `main`, not re-measured by the seat; re-read before acting.

## Expected

When the approvals read answers (any 2xx), the lock follows the open request: no pending request ⇒ no approval lock. The column fallback applies only when the read is absent (404 / no route). Whether a backend without the approvals service should answer 200 `[]` at all is the backend half; if triage routes it there, it is objectstack's.

## Why it matters now

HotCRM 4.0.1 and earlier stamped `pending` on every user-created account. objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2075 stops new ones, but accounts already created on hosted free-plan environments keep `pending` with no request behind it, and the column is `readonly`. Until the console stops locking on the bare column, those records stay locked in the UI.

## Duplicate check

`search_issues` (semantic, objectstack-ai/objectui, all states), two queries:
- "record detail locked for approval approval_status pending without an open approval request" → 10 hits;
- "approvalLocked fallback approvals pendingRequest null RecordDetailView lock" → 9 hits.

None on point. The nearest are #2618 (closed: the band never showed on request-only backends, the opposite direction) and #2902 (closed: the band ignored a node's `lockRecord: false`).

Seam: spec:approval node `approvalStatusField` → renderer: app-shell `RecordDetailView` `approvalLocked` (reads the literal column, not the declared field)
